shortDescription: Manage HA in a Proxmox cluster

options.name: api_host
options.description: Specify the target host of the Proxmox VE cluster.

options.name: api_password
options.description: Specify the password to authenticate with. You can also use the C(PROXMOX_PASSWORD) environment variable.

options.name: api_user
options.description: Specify the user to authenticate with.

options.name: comment
options.description: Add a comment to the HA resource. This comment is not parsed and is only used for documentation.

options.name: digest
options.description: Specify if to prevent changes if current configuration file has different SHA1 digest. This can be used to prevent concurrent modifications.

options.name: group
options.description: Specify the HA group that the guest should be a member of

options.name: max_relocate
options.description: Specify the maximum number of relocates to attempt before a service is considered "failed"

options.name: max_restart
options.description: Specify the maximum number of restarts to attempt before a service is considered "failed"

options.name: name
options.description: Specify the name of the guest whose HA resource will be modified. Automatically fetches the correct VMID. You can also specify the VMID directly using C(vmid).

options.name: state
options.description: C(present): Alias for C(started) C(absent): Will remove the HA resource if present C(started)/C(stopped)/C(disabled)/C(ignored): Will configure the resource and set the PVE HA state to the requested value For more information on the individual states, please refer to the PVE documentation

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Validate SSL certificate of the PVE host upon connecting

options.name: vmid
options.description: Specify the VMID of the guest whose HA resource will be modified. Will be fetched automatically if C(name) is set.
